# Drafting Studio

> Drafting Studio is a US-focused 2D AutoCAD drafting studio. We produce permit-ready 2D drafting sets for engineering firms, contractors, architects and developers: MEP, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, fire protection and lighting, plus engineering calculations and reports. 2D AutoCAD drafting only. We do not do 3D modeling, Revit or BIM, and we do not stamp drawings; the engineer of record reviews and stamps.

Drafting Studio has completed 300+ projects across 20+ US states. Typical turnaround is 3-7 business days. Every set is delivered as a layered DWG plus plotted PDF, QC-checked, with two free minor revisions. Send scope and plans to get a fixed price and delivery date within one business day; no published prices, every job is quoted individually. We draft to the client's CAD standard and current US codes (NEC, IMC, IPC, NFPA 13 and 72, IES). Contact: info@draftingstudio.org, WhatsApp +92 303 0143281.

## Services

- [Services](https://draftingstudio.org/services): 2D AutoCAD drafting services across electrical, mechanical (HVAC and plumbing), fire protection, and engineering calculations and reports.
- [Electrical Design Services](https://draftingstudio.org/services/electrical-design): Power plans, panel schedules, single-line diagrams, lighting and photometrics, fire alarm system design.
- [Mechanical Design Services](https://draftingstudio.org/services/mechanical-design): HVAC design, plumbing design and coordinated mechanical sets.
- [Fire Protection Services](https://draftingstudio.org/services/fire-protection): Sprinkler layout plans and fire alarm system design to NFPA 13 and NFPA 72.
- [Calculations & Reports](https://draftingstudio.org/services/calculations-reports): Electrical load calculations, HVAC heating and cooling loads, sprinkler hydraulic reports and photometric studies.

## Services in detail

- [Electrical System Design](https://draftingstudio.org/services/electrical-design/electrical-system-design): Power plans, panel schedules and distribution for commercial projects.
- [Site Electrical Plan](https://draftingstudio.org/services/electrical-design/site-electrical-plan): Site power, parking lighting and service routing.
- [Single Line Diagram](https://draftingstudio.org/services/electrical-design/single-line-diagram): One-line diagrams for service, distribution and panels.
- [Power Upgrade](https://draftingstudio.org/services/electrical-design/power-upgrade): Service upgrades, load studies and utility coordination.
- [Lighting Design](https://draftingstudio.org/services/electrical-design/lighting-design): Fixture layouts, switching, controls and fixture schedules.
- [Photometric Design](https://draftingstudio.org/services/electrical-design/photometric-design): Point-by-point footcandle grids, uniformity ratios and dark-sky compliance.
- [Fire Alarm System Design](https://draftingstudio.org/services/electrical-design/fire-alarm-system-design): Device layouts, risers and sequence tables to NFPA 72.
- [Mechanical Design](https://draftingstudio.org/services/mechanical-design/mechanical-design): Coordinated HVAC and plumbing sets.
- [HVAC Design](https://draftingstudio.org/services/mechanical-design/hvac-design): Ductwork, equipment and controls layouts.
- [Plumbing Design](https://draftingstudio.org/services/mechanical-design/plumbing-design): Water, waste, vent and gas piping layouts.
- [Sprinkler Layout Plan](https://draftingstudio.org/services/fire-protection/sprinkler-layout-plan): Sprinkler head layouts, branch and main routing to NFPA 13.
- [Electrical Load Calculation](https://draftingstudio.org/services/calculations-reports/electrical-load-calculation): NEC Article 220 connected and demand loads, service sizing.
- [HVAC Heating & Cooling Load](https://draftingstudio.org/services/calculations-reports/hvac-heating-cooling-load): Manual J and ASHRAE heating and cooling load calculations.

## Industries

- [Industries](https://draftingstudio.org/industries): Restaurants, retail, multifamily, healthcare, offices, franchise rollouts and more.
- [Franchise Drafting](https://draftingstudio.org/industries/franchise): Prototype MEP sets adapted per site for multi-location rollouts.
- [Restaurant Drafting](https://draftingstudio.org/industries/restaurant): Kitchen equipment power, hood exhaust, grease and gas piping, fire suppression.
- [Commercial Drafting](https://draftingstudio.org/industries/commercial): Tenant fit-outs and core-and-shell coordinated MEP sets.
- [Healthcare Drafting](https://draftingstudio.org/industries/healthcare): Clinics, dental and medical fit-outs, dedicated power and life-safety.
- [Residential Drafting](https://draftingstudio.org/industries/residential): Single-family, townhome and ADU electrical, HVAC and plumbing plans.
